metric: per-fold pooled five-class Macro-F1, fold-equal paired average
input: Ying OSF gx36m; same-amplifier Days 1 and 2; documented missing Day 2 for 004 and 020
encoding: F4-A1 and EOG-R minus EOG-L; 500 -> 100 -> 200 Hz; frozen W4 30k EMA
target: 3-expert majority; Expert 1 on ties; complete annotation-aligned 30 s epochs; omit author NotScored epochs and use common annotation prefix on SLP010 Day 1
time_matching: same pair of night thirds across all arms; newcomer matched to other_night day
boot: resample held-out people, rosters and paired block draws within fixed folds; conditional on observed cohort
decision: external_support if mean >= 1 pp, lower bound > 0 and >= 3 of 4 fold means positive; below_practical_target if upper bound < 1; otherwise inconclusive
